terms.title: Terms of service
terms.html:
Draft for your lawyer to review. Not yet legal advice or a final policy.

What Songpost does

Songpost makes a personalized song from the details you give us. The lyrics and the music are made with AI.

Who can order

You must be 18 or older to order a song. You are responsible for what you tell us and for the song you ask us to make.

Your song

  • Your song is for personal use. You may play it, share it, download it, and give it as a gift.
  • You may not sell it or use it to promote a business.
  • Music made with AI may not be protected by copyright. We do not promise that you own exclusive rights to your song.
  • We may make songs for other people that sound similar to yours.

What you tell us

You confirm that you have the right to share the details you give us, and any photo or recording you add. Do not include private information about another person that they would not want shared, such as health or money matters.

What we won't make

Songs must follow our content rules. We may refuse to make a song, and we may remove one.

Paying, redos, and refunds

You hear a preview before you pay. Our redo and refund policy is part of these terms.

Keeping your song

Download your song if you want to keep it. Songpost may remove a song's page at any time, with or without notice. We do not promise how long a page stays online.

Messages

We send messages about your song to the email or mobile number you give us. If you ask us to send a song to someone, you confirm that they would welcome it.

No guarantee about what AI produces

A song may contain mistakes, including a name that is sung wrong. The redo is there to fix that. We provide the service as it is.

Limit of our responsibility

If something goes wrong, the most we owe you is what you paid for the song.

Changes and contact

We may change these terms. The version on this page applies. Questions go to {{SUPPORT}}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.html:
Draft for your lawyer to review. Not yet legal advice or a final policy.

What we collect

  • Names: yours, and the person the song is for.
  • What you tell us about them, and the lyrics made from it.
  • Your email or mobile number.
  • The other person's email or mobile number, only if you ask us to send the song for you.
  • Any reply the person writes back to you.
  • What you choose to add to the gift page: a photo, a short recording of your voice, a signature, and any of your own answers you ask us to show there.
  • If you make a song with others: the first name of each person who adds to it, what they write, and their email if they choose to leave it. The person who started the song sees what the others wrote.
  • If you ask for a reminder: the email address to send it to, and the month and day you want to be reminded of.
  • If you ask us to email a song's words to you from its page: the address you type. We use it to send that one email.
  • If the person a song is for records a video on its page: the video. It is sent to the person who gave them the song. We show it to anyone else only if the person who recorded it ticks the box allowing that, and only after we have looked at it.
  • Whether the photo on a song's page may be shown beside a testimonial. We show it only if the person who added it and the person the song is for have both said yes, and only after we have looked at it. Either of them can ask us to take it down.
  • How you found us: your answer if we ask, and whether you arrived from a song someone sent you or from a partner's link. This is remembered on your device for 30 days.
  • Counts of how the site is used, such as how many people reach each step.

Payment is handled by Stripe. We never see your card number.

How we use it

  • To write, record, and deliver your song.
  • To send you the link to your song, your receipt, and a notice when it is played.
  • To tell the people who helped make a song that it is ready, and to show them the reply it received.
  • To send the reminders you asked for. Each one has a link to stop it.
  • To see which ways of finding Songpost work, and to credit a partner whose link brought you here.
  • To improve the service.
  • To show someone's words as a testimonial, only if they ticked the box allowing it.

We do not sell personal information. We do not send marketing messages unless you ask for them. A partner is told how many songs came through their link, never who bought them.

Who else sees it

We share only what each company needs to do its part: Anthropic writes the lyrics and checks a photo you add against our content rules, ElevenLabs or Mureka records the music, Stripe takes payment, and a messaging service sends emails and texts. The person you send the song to, and anyone they share the link with, sees what is on the gift page.

How long we keep it

We keep your details and your song until you ask us to delete them, or until we remove the song.

Your choices

You can ask to see or delete your details and your song. The person a song is about can ask us to remove it. Write to {{SUPPORT}}.

Children

Songpost is not for children. Do not order if you are under 18.

Changes and contact

We may change this policy. The version on this page applies. Questions go to {{SUPPORT}}.

refunds.title: Redo and refund policy
refunds.html:
Draft for your lawyer to review. Not yet legal advice or a final policy.

The short version

You hear your song before you pay. After you pay, you get one free redo. If it still isn't right, you get your money back, as long as you tell us within 7 days of paying.

Before you pay

  • You hear a 30-second preview of your song first.
  • You can record a second take and pick the one you like.
  • You can change the lyrics before either take.
  • If we can't make your song, you are not charged.

One free redo

Within 7 days of paying, you can record your song again, once, for any reason. Open the link we sent you when you paid and choose Record it again. You can change the lyrics for the redo. The new version replaces the old one at the same link.

Money-back guarantee

If you are still not happy after your redo, tell us within 7 days of paying and we refund the full price. If you would rather skip the redo, say so and we will still refund you.

When a song is refunded, its page is taken down and its download stops working. A refunded song may not be kept, shared, or used.

Refunds we give without being asked

  • You were charged twice for the same song.
  • You paid and the full song could not be delivered, and we could not fix it within 2 days.
  • A song you scheduled was not sent on its date because of our mistake. You choose a refund or a new send date.

What is not covered

  • Requests made more than 7 days after paying.
  • A second refund on the same song.
  • Repeated buying and refunding. We may decline orders from someone who does this.

Keeping your song

Download your song if you want to keep it. Songpost may remove a song's page at any time, with or without notice.

How to ask

For a redo, use the link we sent you when you paid. For a refund, or if the redo isn't working, write to {{SUPPORT}} from the email or mobile number you used to order. We answer within 2 business days. Refunds go back to the card you paid with, and banks usually show them within 5 to 10 business days.

content.title: Content rules
content.html:
Draft for your lawyer to review. Not yet legal advice or a final policy.

Songs are gifts

Every song should be something the person would be glad to receive.

We don't make songs that

  • Insult, threaten, harass, or humiliate someone.
  • Are sexual, or are romantic or sexual about anyone under 18.
  • Attack people for who they are.
  • Reveal private information about someone, such as their address, health, or money matters.
  • Say untrue things about a real person that could harm them.
  • Copy an existing song, or imitate a real singer's voice.

Photos, recordings and signatures

A photo, a spoken message, and anything you write or draw on the gift page must follow the same rules as the song. Only add a photo of someone who would be glad to see it there. A photo is checked automatically before it appears. Spoken messages and signatures are not checked first, and can be reported like any song.

Songs about children

Songs for a child are welcome from a parent, guardian, or family member. Use first names only.

Reporting a song

Every song page has a link to report a problem. If a song is about you and you want it removed, tell us there or write to {{SUPPORT}}. We review every report and may remove the song.

Our right to say no

We may refuse to make any song and may remove any song.
